task.title: Acorn Vaultwarden Package Update
task.purpose: Deploy Vaultwarden 1.37.0 from an isolated Nixpkgs input without advancing the primary system pin, while repairing the reviewed auth-mini source pin that blocked the required Axiom build.

summary: Acorn now runs Vaultwarden 1.37.0 and the reviewed auth-mini latest-2026-07-24 package. The primary Nixpkgs lock was unchanged; build, transfer, activation, backup preflight, and status-only health checks succeeded from Axiom.

attention.summary: Deployment evidence passes. The user reviewed and accepted the unaudited upstream auth-mini binary and deferred Vaultwarden restore-drill residual risks.
attention.humanAction: Completed on 2026-07-30: the user accepted the recorded residual risks and authorized commit, PR creation, and merge.
attention.lifecycleBoundary: The residual-risk gate is cleared; normal required checks, review, conflict, and branch-protection gates still apply.
attention.stopPoint: Stop only if a required check, review, conflict, or merge-protection gate fails.

claims.statement: The Vaultwarden backup can be fully restored during a real disaster.
claims.impact: A successful backup job alone does not prove recovery fidelity for credential data.
claims.mitigation: A fresh SQLite backup succeeded before this deployment; no deployment claim treats that result as a restore proof.

deferredProtocol.trigger: Within 90 days after deployment, or at the first backup failure, rollback attempt, or storage anomaly, whichever occurs first.
deferredProtocol.method: Restore a named backup in an isolated, non-public environment with a non-production environment file and no production egress; confirm service start, SQLite open, and local health before securely destroying the isolated copy.

requiredData.name: Named Vaultwarden backup snapshot
requiredData.acceptance: The snapshot timestamp and protected handling are recorded without exposing vault data.

requiredData.name: Isolated restore environment
requiredData.acceptance: It has no public reachability and uses a non-production environment file.

deferredProtocol.stopCondition: Stop and clean up if the restored service cannot start, SQLite cannot open, public reachability appears, or secure isolation and deletion cannot be guaranteed.

onPass.nextAction: Record the drill evidence and add verified recovery steps to maintenance knowledge.
onPass.conclusionUpdate: Update restore-fidelity from DEFERRED to PASS.

onFail.nextAction: Create or resume the restore-drill repair phase and retain the recovery risk as unresolved.
onFail.conclusionUpdate: Keep restore-fidelity unresolved and do not equate backup success with recoverability.

changes: Added a dedicated nixpkgs-vaultwarden input, leaving the primary Nixpkgs and shared unstable revisions unchanged.
Set both Vaultwarden server and Web Vault packages from the same isolated package set.

verification.label: Fresh backup, Axiom build, transfer, activation, and health checks

risks.risk: Vaultwarden migration behavior and recovery fidelity cannot be fully proven by a non-destructive deployment.
risks.mitigation: A fresh backup completed within the RFC time bound; the isolated restore-drill protocol is deferred with a concrete owner, trigger, and stop condition.

risks.risk: The auth-mini upstream binary is trusted through official asset metadata and fixed-output integrity rather than an independent audit.
risks.mitigation: The asset ID, official digest, SRI conversion, full build, and non-authenticated health checks all agree; future source drift fails closed.
